title: Set up and prove the basics

steps.title: 1 Inputs
steps.body: Link your intake, design record, and readiness checklist.

steps.title: 2 Datasource
steps.body: Configure from code, then read it back; reconcile ambiguous failures by reading state.

steps.title: 3 First run
steps.body: One public document visible; one permissioned document visible only to authorized personas.

steps.title: 4 Identities
steps.body: Users, then groups including nested, then memberships. Record identity counts.

steps.title: 5 Full run under faults
steps.body: Logs show 429 retries and a raised completeness error; the retry run completes.
